hook: A reinforcement-learned chest X-ray report model beats prior systems on the ReXrank benchmark
hook_turn: beats prior systems on the ReXrank benchmark
summary: Models fine-tuned to write radiology reports often generalize poorly across hospitals. This 8-billion-parameter model adds reinforcement learning against rewards for wording, meaning and clinical errors, and scored best on ReXrank with fewer significant errors. Scores are automated metrics plus expert review, not a trial of use in patient care.
title: Scaling medical imaging report generation with multimodal reinforcement learning
